verdict.rationale: Decagon lets teams define agent behavior and logic in natural language through AOPs, which can retrieve data and take actions via integrations. Watchtower applies custom natural-language criteria to every interaction to flag events, and proactive agents reach out to customers at the right moments based on customer signals. All of this is vendor-claimed, and none of it describes an explicit event-trigger rule engine; Watchtower's documented response to a match is only surfacing or flagging. Missing for 10: an explicit event→action rule or trigger configuration, documented event types or webhooks, automated actions beyond flagging when criteria match, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
